evidence: The MoO3 based TCL structure is further confirmed by (TEM) studied. To prepare the TEM samples, sonication of the annealed sample (100 cycle and Tann = 750 /C176C) in ethanol was processed, followed by fishing the TCL structures using the carbon coated copper TEM grids from the ethanol. Fig. 3(a) presents a typical TEM image of the freestanding TCL structure, its larger magnified image is shown in Fig. 3(b), which does not exhibit any lattice related features. It is further confirmed by using selective area electron diffraction (SAED) that the TCL structure acutely consisted of amorphous solids without any crystallites.
